title: BCI Competition 2020 Track 5 — ERP during walking (scalp, ear-EEG, and IMU)
description: EEG recordings from 15 healthy participants performing a visual P300 oddball task while walking on a treadmill at 1.6 m/s, released as BCI Competition 2020 Track 5. The dataset combines 46-channel scalp EEG, 14-channel ear-EEG, 4 EOG channels, and 6 inertial measurement unit channels. It is intended for evaluating brain-computer interface performance under ambulatory conditions, with trials divided temporally into training, validation, and test sets.
methods_description: Participants viewed target ('OOO') and non-target ('XXX') stimuli (target ratio 0.2) while walking on a treadmill at 1.6 m/s. Scalp EEG (46 channels, 10-20 montage), ear-EEG (7 channels per ear), EOG (4 channels) and IMU (3-axis accelerometer and gyroscope) were recorded at 100 Hz. Data were epoched from -190 ms to +800 ms around stimulus onset.
